source_text: In countries like Tanzania and Eswatini, national policies often require parental or guardian consent for minors under 18, alongside adolescent assent, yet studies reveal frequent lapses: up to 10% of procedures on Kenyan youth aged 15-19 occurred without documented parental approval, including instances of forged signatures or absent forms. [104]
